tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Brand: butter yellow. The remote body, on screen and in PLA. Fixed in both themes; text on it is on-butter.

tokens.name: oxblood
tokens.usage: Brand: oxblood. Lettering, the mark's O, the navigation keycaps. Fixed in both themes; for text use ink, which is oxblood in Ivory and ivory in Late show.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Brand: burnt orange. The power key, the mark's C, the one playful colour. Fixed; a fill only (3.7:1 on ivory — never small text). As text use accent-text.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Brand: warm ivory. The page ground in the Ivory theme and the legend colour on dark caps. Fixed.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and app background: ivory by day, deep oxblood-black for Late show.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, menus, the properties sidebar.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Sunken UI: segmented tracks, input fields, the tool-rail tray. Not the remote body — that is tray.

tokens.name: tray
tokens.usage: The remote body wherever keys are drawn on screen: the layout editor, the Key preview, the cover. Butter in both themes. Alias-free so a theme never recolours the product.

tokens.name: tray-deep
tokens.usage: The shell's rounded edge and the shadow a cap throws on the tray; hairlines on butter.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers that carry no meaning. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders on ground and ground-raised (3:1 or better in both themes). On butter use oxblood.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text and the wordmark: oxblood on ground, ground-raised, well and accent-soft in Ivory (9:1); ivory on the Late show grounds (15:1). Not for text on butter — see on-butter.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and spec labels on ground and ground-raised (5.3:1 and 8.9:1). Not on butter.

tokens.name: on-butter
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on butter — the wordmark on the shell, labels on the tray — in both themes (7.4:1). Always oxblood: butter never gets ivory lettering.

tokens.name: cap-ivory
tokens.usage: The ivory keycap: every key that is not navigation or power. Fill of quiet buttons.

tokens.name: cap-ivory-side
tokens.usage: Side of an ivory cap (shadow-cap-ivory). Never text.

tokens.name: on-cap-ivory
tokens.usage: Legends on ivory caps: oxblood in both themes (9.9:1).

tokens.name: cap-oxblood
tokens.usage: The oxblood keycap: the navigation cluster (arrows and OK) and the primary button.

tokens.name: cap-oxblood-side
tokens.usage: Side of an oxblood cap (shadow-cap-oxblood). Never text.

tokens.name: on-cap-oxblood
tokens.usage: Legends and labels on oxblood caps and the primary button: ivory in both themes (9.3:1 and 7:1).

tokens.name: cap-orange
tokens.usage: The power keycap and nothing else. One per remote, one per screen.

tokens.name: cap-orange-side
tokens.usage: Side of the orange cap (shadow-cap-orange). Never text.

tokens.name: on-cap-orange
tokens.usage: The power glyph on the orange cap: ivory by day (3.7:1 — glyphs 24px+ and bold text 19px+ only, never small text), dark in Late show (5.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Burnt orange as text: links, the selected option, counts. On ground, ground-raised, butter and accent-soft (4.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent-text: the pressed option in Segmented, hover on accent rows.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Paired, printable, routed. A jade that sits off the red–green axis from alert; always with a word or glyph. Text on ground or ok-soft.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind ok text.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Faults: unpaired, a wall under wall-min, an overhang over overhang-max, DRC errors, destructive buttons. Text on ground or alert-soft; always with a word or glyph.

tokens.name: alert-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind alert text.

tokens.name: viewport
tokens.usage: The 3D viewport ground plane behind the model — a shade below ground so the butter shell reads as an object on a table.

tokens.name: grid-minor
tokens.usage: Viewport grid, 1 mm lines.

tokens.name: grid-major
tokens.usage: Viewport grid, every 19.05 mm (one key unit). Decorative.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: 2px outline of the selected key or part in the viewport (5:1 on viewport in Ivory, 9.5:1 in Late show). Alias of accent-text.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links. Alias of accent-text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour (see shadow focus-ring). Alias of accent-text.

families.sans: "Fredoka", "Avenir Next Rounded", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", sans-serif

groups.name: Lettering
groups.note: Fraunces, hosted on Google Fonts with its SOFT axis pinned at 100 and WONK on: a chunky, rounded serif at 900, a warm readable text face at 400–600. One family for the wordmark and for everything that is a sentence.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The wordmark and hero headlines only. Weight 900, optical size 144, leading 1.0.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Pick a remote to start from

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every key is a real mechanical switch. Pull the cap, swap the switch, keep the remote.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Ships as a kit, half-built, or ready to click.

groups.name: Labels & legends
groups.note: Fredoka, hosted on Google Fonts (400–700): a rounded sans for keycap legends, captions, badges and measurements — the appliance-label voice beside the serif.

styles.name: legend
styles.usage: Text legends on keycaps in the editor and on Key. Uppercase, four characters at most on a 1u key.

styles.name: legend-lg
styles.usage: Legends on 1.5u and 2u keys and on the OK key.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above fields, badge text, the back-badge lettering.

styles.name: spec
styles.usage: Dimensions, pitches, part numbers, pin labels.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: The system monospace; no hosted face. Only for things typed into a terminal.

spacing.note: 4px base. space-u is one key unit on screen: 19.05 mm at 4 px/mm, the pitch of the layout editor.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-label gap; the gap between keycaps at space-u pitch.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and compact controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections in a panel; the shell margin around a key field (6 mm at 4 px/mm).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: The shell chin below the key field, where the wordmark sits (20 mm at 4 px/mm).

tokens.name: space-u
tokens.usage: One key unit (1u) in the layout editor: pitch 19.05 mm at 4 px/mm. A 1u keycap is space-u minus space-1 = 72px.

radius.note: Chunky and rounded, like an appliance. Keycap and shell radii are the hardware values at 4 px/mm.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, hairline chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, segmented tracks, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Keycaps and every Key or Button: the 2 mm cap-fillet at 4 px/mm.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels inside the tool, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the back badge.

tokens.name: radius-shell
tokens.usage: The remote body in any 2D rendering: the 8 mm shell-fillet at 4 px/mm.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The OK dot and the monogram rings. Nothing else is round.

shadow.note: Keys sit, they don't float. Hard cap sides that collapse on press, one soft float for menus, and the focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-cap-ivory
tokens.usage: The resting side under an ivory Key, a quiet Button or a Segmented option: 2px of cap-ivory-side. Pressed removes it and drops the cap 2px.

tokens.name: shadow-cap-oxblood
tokens.usage: The side under an oxblood Key or the primary Button: 2px of cap-oxblood-side.

tokens.name: shadow-cap-orange
tokens.usage: The side under the power key: 2px of cap-orange-side.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the command palette. The only soft shadow in the system, tinted oxblood by day.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in ground, then a 2px solid ring in focus (accent-text). Box-shadow so it follows the radius; at least 4.6:1 on every surface it lands on.

hardware.note: The physical design language, in millimetres. The enclosure generator reads these and the printability check enforces them; a value here is a rule.

tokens.name: pitch-mx
tokens.usage: Key pitch for MX-style switches. The default grid of every template.

tokens.name: pitch-choc-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal key pitch for Kailh Choc low-profile builds.

tokens.name: pitch-choc-y
tokens.usage: Vertical key pitch for Kailh Choc low-profile builds.

tokens.name: cap-1u
tokens.usage: Keycap footprint on a pitch-mx grid, leaving a 1.05 mm gap.

tokens.name: cap-fillet
tokens.usage: Corner radius of a keycap seen from above; radius-key on screen.

tokens.name: cap-dish
tokens.usage: Depth of the cylindrical dish across the top of every cap — the sculpted shape a thumb finds without looking. Printable caps carry it; bought caps should too (Cherry or SA profile).

tokens.name: cap-side-visible
tokens.usage: How much cap side a 2D rendering shows below the top. The origin of the shadow-cap tokens.

tokens.name: plate-cutout
tokens.usage: Square switch cutout in the plate, MX.

tokens.name: plate-thickness
tokens.usage: Switch plate so MX clips engage. Printed, FR4 or aluminium.

tokens.name: pcb-thickness
tokens.usage: Every generated PCB.

tokens.name: shell-margin
tokens.usage: From the outermost key edge to the outer face of the shell on the sides and top; space-6 on screen. Wide enough for the M2 bosses to sit outside the key field.

tokens.name: shell-chin
tokens.usage: The bezel below the key field that carries the wordmark; space-20 on screen. Every remote has one.

tokens.name: shell-fillet
tokens.usage: Corner radius of the shell seen from above; radius-shell on screen. Appliance-soft.

tokens.name: shell-edge-fillet
tokens.usage: The rounded edge where the face meets the sides. The shell prints face-up (open back on the bed), so this convex fillet prints clean without supports.

tokens.name: wall
tokens.usage: Standard shell wall (five 0.4 mm perimeters).

tokens.name: wall-min
tokens.usage: Thinnest wall the tool allows; below this is an alert.

tokens.name: floor
tokens.usage: Shell face and lid thickness.

tokens.name: overhang-max
tokens.usage: Steepest unsupported overhang; the generator never produces more and the printability check flags more as alert.

tokens.name: layer-height
tokens.usage: Reference layer height for every tolerance below.

tokens.name: nozzle
tokens.usage: Reference nozzle; walls are multiples of it.

tokens.name: fit-press
tokens.usage: Per-side clearance for a press fit (switch into printed plate).

tokens.name: fit-slide
tokens.usage: Per-side clearance for a sliding fit (lid into shell, battery door).

tokens.name: insert-m2-bore
tokens.usage: Bore for an M2 heat-set insert.

tokens.name: insert-m2-depth
tokens.usage: Depth of the M2 heat-set insert boss; bosses are 6 mm across.

tokens.name: screw-m2
tokens.usage: Every fastener is M2; the lid takes four, one in each corner, from the back, heads showing.

tokens.name: badge-w
tokens.usage: The back badge: an ivory label plate recessed 0.4 mm into the lid, carrying the mark and OPEN SOURCE · MIT LICENSE.

tokens.name: badge-h
tokens.usage: Height of the back badge.

tokens.name: wordmark-h
tokens.usage: Cap height of the wordmark on the chin — "Open" over "Clicker", two lines, left-aligned with the key field — in oxblood, 0.4 mm debossed or printed.

tokens.name: ir-window-w
tokens.usage: IR emitter window on the top edge of IR variants, centred.

tokens.name: ir-window-h
tokens.usage: Height of the IR window slot.

tokens.name: legend-cap-height
tokens.usage: Cap height of a text legend on a 1u key.

tokens.name: legend-glyph
tokens.usage: Bounding square of a glyph legend on a 1u key.
